radegs.api: gsplat.rasterization(..., RadeGS=True) or low-level fully_fused_projection/isect_tiles/rasterize_to_pixels; unpacked only
radegs.moment_backend: gsplat-radegs-moments: native per-pixel geometry and weights, 9 polynomial moments for detached-weight L2; no L1 output
radegs.stable_moment_backend: gsplat-radegs-stable-moments: native RGB/conic projection and rasterization; explicitly differentiable float64 Cholesky ray-plane geometry. Same port regularization/FOV equations, not its approximate float32 VJP. New named operator contract; fresh training run required.
radegs.training_schedule: RaDe-GS paper v2 section 4.1.1: first 15k photometric-only, next 15k geometric losses; previous 1k warmup was a recipe error and is retired
radegs.rgb_only_optimization: public native RGB path with identical colors/support; gated by value and parameter-gradient comparison, no replacement renderer
radegs.submodules: glm from g-truc/glm, permissive license; preserve upstream notices

depth_anything3.configuration: training views only; supplied COLMAP poses/intrinsics and input-pose scale alignment; resolution 504; windows 12, overlap 4; resample to full input resolution using intrinsics
depth_anything3.paper_difference: DA3-BASE replaces the paper's noncommercial Nested-Giant weight; window size also differs. Not paper-equivalent.
depth_anything3.dependency_boundary: optional external SDK/runtime, not vendored; transitive licenses still require their own compliance review

shared_engine_correctness.ssim_layout: Explicit NCHW contiguous pooling, unchanged forward values/window/dtype. Real Object1 directional VJPs and 20-update descent controls validate this workaround for the current Torch 2.1 CUDA layout path; not a statement about all Torch versions.
shared_engine_correctness.initialization: Opt-in training-mask-consistent COLMAP seed selection; >=2 foreground observations and zero observed background; no held-out image/mask input or coordinate normalization.
shared_engine_correctness.cuda_composite: Independent Apache-2.0 CUDA float32 implementation of selected alpha-compositing values and VJPs; native Torch sort indices retained for L1 ties; detached L2 weights; no target restricted code. Explicit opt-in backend, 16 GPU fixture cases passed, real-object validation separately recorded.
shared_engine_correctness.tile_binning: Per-footprint construction with exact inclusive tile boundaries and globally stable depth order; exhaustive-list comparison regression, not a support reduction.

search_result: No complete permissive AmbiSuR/GOF gsplat port found. Exact AmbiSuR and Gaussian Opacity Fields plus gsplat repository searches were checked, along with author repository license texts.
claim_status: experimental implementation; neither paper-equivalence nor legal certification
